assets.desc: ground viewed from above at the 3/4 top-down game camera: dense short wild meadow grass covering the whole ground, olive and fresh green blades mixed with a few dry straw ones, tiny clover. Painted in the same style as hand-painted Project Zomboid-like sprites: visible individual grass blades and tufts with volume, every tuft lit from the top-left with lighter tips and darker roots, small shadow pockets between tufts, muted natural colors, no large objects, no stones bigger than a fist, uniform density so it tiles
